summary: Phase 3 backend testing complete. All 28 tests PASS (100%): 22 previous tests (auth, entity CRUD, gemmaChat w/ Claude Opus 4.5, orchestrateAgent, predictResonance, testSkill, checkPriceAlerts, indexDocument, retrieveContext, unknown fn 404) + 6 new Phase 3 tests (CoinGecko market/prices auth & data, checkPriceAlerts using real AQ basket + change24h, indexDocument no-embedding TF-IDF mode, retrieveContext relevant query similarity>0, retrieveContext irrelevant query no-crash). CoinGecko was reachable; BTC/ETH/SOL returned non-zero USD values and synthetic AQ price computed from basket > 0. TF-IDF retrieval works: 'staking gold APY' returns ranked hits from the seeded AEGIS-Q whitepaper + freshly indexed doc with similarity > 0.

minor.issue: Telegram dispatch is MOCKED (declared). Only last_alert_date is updated; no real notification sent.

On CoinGecko failure endpoint returns 200 with usd=0 (silent fallback). Current test asserts >0 assuming upstream is up — if rate-limited in CI this would fail. Consider surfacing an upstream_status field.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1182 lines — should be split into modules (auth.py, entities.py, functions/market.py, functions/rag.py, seed.py) for maintainability. Carried over from iteration_1.

TF-IDF IDF is recomputed over the full corpus on every retrieveContext call (O(N*chunks)). Fine for seed corpus (<50 chunks) but will scale poorly. Cache IDF in-memory keyed on doc-set revision, or persist precomputed chunk vectors on indexDocument.
_fetch_coingecko cache is process-local and not concurrency-safe (two simultaneous misses will both hit the API). Add an asyncio.Lock around the fetch-on-miss path.

_compute_aq_price guards division with 'or 1' but then multiplies by small weights — if CoinGecko returns 0s, AQ becomes 1*0.00002+1*0.0004+1*0.005 ≈ 0.0054, not 0. Then test_market_prices_authenticated's assertion aq.usd>0 passes artificially even on upstream outage. Prefer explicit status propagation.
/api/market/prices returns 200 even when upstream CoinGecko is down (with zeroed coins). Prefer 503 or include an 'upstream_ok' flag so clients can warn users that prices are stale.

checkPriceAlerts defaults current_price from AQ basket but still accepts an override via body — document precedence clearly; also no direction-change (crossed-up vs crossed-down) detection still → alert spam risk.
gemmaChat still replays prior user messages via N separate chat.send_message calls (O(N) upstream Claude calls per turn). Highly expensive at scale. Carried over from iteration_1.
JWT_SECRET default in code ('aegis-q-sovereign-secret-change-me') — should fail fast if env var missing in prod. Carried over from iteration_1.

_STOP_WORDS is French+English mixed but the tokenizer strips apostrophes before checking — e.g. 'd'inflation' becomes tokens ['d','inflation']; 'd' is in stop list so fine. However single-char tokens with accents (À-ÿ) may slip through — verify with French tests.
TF-IDF tokenizer does not stem/lemmatize, so 'staking' vs 'stake' vs 'stakes' are different tokens. For the current seed this is OK, but flag as limitation vs real embeddings.
seed_data_creation: Uses existing seed from startup (MemoryNodes, AuditEvents, Agents, Skills, Proposals, 1 KB doc). Tests create a few TEST_ prefixed KnowledgeDocuments (left persisted) + ephemeral MemoryNodes (deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 28 backend tests pass at https://hybrid-federated-ia.preview.emergentagent.com.
